shared_elements: human or humanoid head shown with facial features
carved figural relief/sculpture of a head with patterned covering (headdress/cap vs. crosshatched surface)
justification: Both depict human-like heads with facial features and incised surface detailing — in A a single, near-frontal, blocky face framed by a crosshatched net-like covering, in B a procession of bearded figures in strict profile wearing fluted crowns, in registers with a rosette band. The correspondence is limited to the generic fact of the human head; the specific forms (frontal isolated monstrous/blocky face vs. repeated profile courtiers in a ranked file), the naturalistic patterned relief conventions of B, and the presence of a repeating ornamental band in B are entirely different.
